sources.title: feverdoingwork/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4-mini-Starlight · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B in 12.62 GiB for Starlight on NVIDIA Blackwell cards. NVFP4-mini keeps the weights in NVFP4 (4-bit floating point with block scales); the gate and up projections of every layer are re-made from the BF16 checkpoint at 3 bits, which is what makes the file small enough for one 16 GB card.
